items.detail: Settlement over funding unfair subprime auto loans, filed in Suffolk Superior Court; date is the announcement date. Amount is $16 million consumer relief plus a $6 million payment to Massachusetts. excluded_amounts.reason: Release: the settlement "includes $16 million in relief to more than 2,000 affected consumers and a $6 million payment to Massachusetts"; it later says eligible consumers will be contacted about "payments" by a trustee but never says how much of the $16 million is cash and how much is loan relief. Counted: the $6 million payment. Owner decision 2026-10-11: kept out of the totals because the release does not state the cash part; revisit if a release or order states it.
